tspan.tspan: 显式前向欧拉导致相空间膨胀与外旋飞散

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 同时读取旧位置 x_n 与旧速度 v_n

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 沿旧圆周切线直走: x_next = x_n + dt * v_n

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 相空间雅可比行列式 det M = 1 + h^2 = 1.016384 > 1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 结果: 第 28 步半径从 3.20 u 炸飞至 4.02 u, 能量暴涨 +57.62%!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 半步速度推进: v_half = v_n + 0.5 * dt * a_n

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 整步位置推进: x_next = x_n + dt * v_half

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 求值并缓存新加速度 a_next, 完成下半步速度推进

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 结果: det M 恒等于 1.000000, 半径锁死 3.2000 u, 能量漂移 0.00%!
